__note: Illustrated permanent time/Slice controls. Regions exclude atlas spacing; buttons clip to their beveled outlines at draw time.

pause.label: Pause / resume
pause.tooltip: Pause the settlement, or resume at the previous speed.

play.label: Normal speed · 1×
play.tooltip: Resume the settlement at normal speed.

fast.label: Fast speed · 2×
fast.tooltip: Resume the settlement at twice normal speed.

slice.label: Slice view
slice.tooltip: Toggle Slice (\). Your previous level is remembered. Scroll over the height tower for one level; Ctrl + scroll for four.
